title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every content schema. All gameplay numbers are integers (frames, units, percent) so the 60-tick loop stays deterministic (C1, F3).

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case id; also the file name without .json.

yokai.description: Source of an ability (A8). 'ryo' = Ryo's starters.

status.description: 'proposed' marks values awaiting a designer decision (open questions, untuned first passes).

ruleIds.description: Rule IDs from docs/design/rules.md this content implements or depends on.

card.description: Reward card text (A12): plain language first, frame data behind a toggle.

frames.description: Text shown when the frame-data toggle is on.

frameRange.description: Inclusive [first, last] frame, 1-based, counted from the move's first frame.

rect.description: 2D rectangle in gameplay units (1 unit = 1 px at 1920x1080), relative to the character origin at the feet, x toward the opponent, y up (F3, F4).

condition.description: When an effect applies. Every condition is game state the fight can see, never a button press (P6).

effect.description: One data-only change to a move (A4, A5, A10). Integer values: frames, units, or percent for mul_pct (130 = x1.3).

target.description: Dotted path into frame data, e.g. 'recovery', 'damage', 'projectile.speed', 'meter_gain.on_block', 'properties.armour'.
